name: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX)
overview: DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) là in-memory cache tương thích DynamoDB API để giảm read latency cho eligible read-heavy workloads.
examSignals: Microsecond read caching for DynamoDB with minimal application changes: DAX
Cache multiple data sources/custom Redis commands: ElastiCache

compareWith.diff: DAX cache layer chuyên cho DynamoDB API; ElastiCache cung cấp cache engine/protocol tổng quát hơn.
